description.value: Dinesty Dumpling House is Greater Vancouver's leading Chinese restaurant chain, founded in Richmond in 2006 and celebrated for its handcrafted Xiaolongbao (soup dumplings) made with natural chicken broth, double-ground pork, and ultra-thin hand-kneaded wrappers. The chain has won multiple prestigious Chinese Restaurant Awards and Diner's Choice honours for best soup dumpling and best Shanghainese restaurant. Touring cyclists can stop in for a full sit-down meal or take-out dumplings across several Richmond and Vancouver locations.
